head: 0ec637e34a2e5185848b35fd2156333567c15d4c
specification: EPIC3-A: Names are stored normalised. In WidgetStore.Add, normalise the name with a new private static Normalise(string) that trims and lower-cases it (invariant culture), used inside the new Widget(...) expression. Add unit tests in WidgetNameNormalisationTests.cs: Add("  Alpha ") returns a widget named alpha.

findings.message: Normalise has no null guard, so Add(null) now throws NullReferenceException where it previously stored a widget with a null name; confirm Program.cs's request.Name cannot be null or add a guard.
